name: Greg Leonard
description: Named contributor in sourced geospatial conference and publication records.
story: GeoCart 2014 accepted abstracts, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Greg Leonard as an author of “Hydrologically adaptive regular tessellations for urban drainage modelling”.
GeoCart 2016 conference programme, New Zealand Cartographic Society lists Greg Leonard as an author of “An augmented-reality sand-based 3D terrain interface”.

Cartographies of change: GeoCart 2018 proceedings, National Library of New Zealand record 40158196 lists Greg Leonard as an author of “Dissecting the GPS track”; “A tangible interface for land development teaching”.

Predicting potential anchor ice formation sites in coastal Antarctic waters, SIRC NZ 2013 citation, University of Otago lists Greg Leonard as an author of “Predicting potential anchor ice formation sites in coastal Antarctic waters”.
